english.title: Act as flight information service officer when unlicensed to do so
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[acted]_
(B)_[held yourself out as a person who may act]_

as a flight information service officer at the

(C)_[aerodrome]_
(D)_[area control centre]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when

(E)_[you did not hold and comply with the terms of a flight information service officer's licence granted under the Air Navigation Order 2016 authorising the holder to act as such an officer at that place]_
(F)_[you did not identify yourself in the manner notified]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 199 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
acted or held yourself out as a person who may act
as a flight information service officer
at an aerodrome or area control centre
when you did not hold and comply with the terms of a flight information service officer's licence granted under the Order authorising the holder to act as such an officer at that place OR
when you did not identify yourself in the manner notified

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
